name: OpenAGI / Lux

modes.label: Bring your own computer
modes.note: Inference token pricing; no Lux VM-hour price found. Unspecified guest OS is not a selectable OS guarantee.

plans.name: Lux API
plans.note: Model-only API: all Lux models (lux-actor-1, lux-thinker-1, TaskerAgent on actor) $0.10 per 1M input tokens and $0.90 per 1M output tokens. Prepaid balance via Stripe (preset top-ups $10/$20/$50/$100/$200 or custom; coupons); requests fail with HTTP 402 insufficient_balance at zero balance. No hosted computer is sold; the customer supplies the machine. New-account registration is currently paused on the developer console (REGISTRATION_PAUSED=true, 'Registration Paused / We'll be back soon').

features.ip_note: SDK executes actions on the user's own machine (pyautogui/ydotool handlers); no hosted IPs or proxies documented.

caveats: Storage, snapshot GiB-month and public IPv4 prices are not published in the reviewed sources; null is not free.

No guaranteed vCPU allocation published; browser-hour is not a verified 4-vCPU/8-GiB VM equivalent. The sizes card keeps unknown hardware null; do not coerce it to zero or auto-rank against resource-guaranteed VMs.
Browser RAM is not published unless a specific mode overrides it.
Model Pricing page rendered with real Chrome; static HTML contains only application shell. Do not turn low token prices into browser-hour prices.
SDK controls screenshots and action handlers; that is not evidence of bundled CPU/RAM, proxy, storage, GPU or OS rental.

Billing is prepaid only (Stripe top-ups, preset $10/$20/$50/$100/$200 or custom, coupons); terms: fees 'debited to you in advance', no refunds of prepaid fees; API returns 402 insufficient_balance when balance is exhausted (hard stop, no overage).

Rate limits exist but no numbers are published: API reference lists 429 rate_limit_exceeded ('Rate limit exceeded. Please retry after 60 seconds.'); terms refer to 'your API rate limits and usage plan'.

audit_2026_09_29.source: checked against the provider's live pricing and docs pages

fleet.verification: Email/Google/GitHub signup with reCAPTCHA; prepaid Stripe balance
fleet.notes: No hosted machines: fleet size is bounded only by the customer's own computers and unpublished API rate limits (429 'retry after 60 seconds'). New registrations are paused (REGISTRATION_PAUSED=true) as of 2026-09-29, so a brand-new customer currently cannot onboard self-serve.
